HOW EACH CLASSROOM IS RUN

Smaller groups.
More room to know every child.

Kabira keeps class strength to a maximum of around 20 children, so the structure of a classroom itself supports individual attention rather than working against it.

Up to 20 children · 1 lead teacher

CLASS SIZE

Maximum 20 children.

A smaller class means a teacher can notice participation, confidence and pace for each child, not just the room as a whole.

CLASSROOM TEAM

A class teacher, plus dedicated support.

Each class has a teacher who leads learning, with dedicated classroom support through LKG — so day-to-day comfort and routine are looked after while the teacher focuses on teaching.

KNOWING EACH CHILD

Individuals, not just a class list.

Teachers are encouraged to notice strengths, confidence, communication and areas needing a little more encouragement, for every child by name.

Read about our approach to additional learning support ↗︎
